**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refresh reference snapshots when fetching an existing object**

When a dashboard's viewers change on the server after it was loaded, calling `dashboard.fetch()` and then `dashboard.roles = []; dashboard.save()` retains those viewers instead of revoking access. `ApiModelFactories.fetch()` assigns the refreshed fields but never updates `_read_keys` or `_read_references`, so this comparison mistakes freshly fetched server data for an explicit subject assignment and merges it into the clearing operation. The same issue affects replacing roles and owners on refreshed objects. Update the read-reference bookkeeping during `fetch()` so deprecated aliases preserve their replacement semantics.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L111-L112](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/f09692d421a759392c9b246478a3870a3e4166b8/AGENTS.md#L111-L112)
